source.description: One reviewed six-panel graphite-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one left-facing classic motorcycle in a stable side view with exactly two wheels, one fuel tank, one stepped seat, one triangular frame, one single-cylinder engine, one front fork, one handlebar, one round headlamp, two fenders, one exhaust pipe, one chain route, visible spokes, and one broken ground shadow.

process_strategy: Reserve both wheel ellipses, the frame triangle, tank, seat, engine, fork, headlamp, fenders, exhaust, chain, and shadow in pale construction; convert those same guides into persistent side-view contours; stop the frame and chain behind the engine and wheel hubs; add hardware, graphite texture, and restrained color before limiting the final panel to keeper-line and value cleanup.

final_elements.name: pale motorcycle wheel frame tank seat hardware and shadow construction
final_elements.description: Two equal wheel ellipses on one ground line plus pale routes for the triangular frame, fuel tank, stepped seat, engine block, front fork, handlebar, headlamp, fenders, exhaust, chain, and broken shadow.

final_elements.name: two wheels frame fork tank seat and fender contours
final_elements.description: Exactly two circular wheels joined by one triangular frame, one slanted front fork, one rounded fuel tank, one stepped seat, and two close-fitting fenders in a stable left-facing side view.

final_elements.name: engine headlamp handlebar exhaust chain and hub hardware
final_elements.description: One readable single-cylinder engine, round headlamp, compact handlebar, low exhaust pipe, chain route, two hubs, and simple foot controls fitted to the established frame.

final_elements.name: spoke tread fin cable and broken shadow details
final_elements.description: A simplified persistent spoke rhythm in both wheels, modest tire tread, engine fins, two cable curves, chain links, and one broken graphite ground shadow.

final_elements.name: restrained navy rust silver and warm-brown colored-pencil accents
final_elements.description: Sparse navy on the tank and fenders, rust on the seat, cool silver-gray on the engine and exhaust, and warm brown on tire sidewalls with open paper highlights.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Frame tubes stop at the reserved engine silhouette, the chain stops behind both hubs and engine case, the fork stops at the front hub, and the exhaust passes in front only where its route was reserved in construction.

rejection_checks: Keep one left-facing motorcycle, one side view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly two equal wheels plus the same tank, seat, frame, fork, engine, headlamp, fenders, exhaust, and chain after those routes appear; no landmark may disappear and return.
Frame tubes, chain, fork, hubs, and exhaust must meet only at reserved overlaps; no keeper line may be erased to fake mechanical assembly.
Do not add a rider, logo, lettering, brand mark, second vehicle, road scene, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or decorative border.
The final panel may not introduce a wheel, hardware part, spoke region, texture cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must look like tactile graphite and colored pencil on warm paper, not glossy concept art, photorealism, or rasterized vector illustration.
